title: Betting updates without DataGolf
description: Betting and site updates can publish when model refresh fails, retaining saved predictions with a visible freshness warning. Normal refresh retries automatically.

title: Unified betting performance
description: ROI and Tournament P/L now share year/tour filters, period/player/tournament views and running P/L. Explicit settled-only and include-pending modes preserve the previous calculation conventions.

title: 2027 schedule preview
description: Styled season and tour filters let you explore 2026 and provisional 2027 schedules, retaining Rolex, Major, Signature and Playoff colour highlights. Future-season data stays separate from current model inputs.

title: Clearer site navigation
description: Separate Predictions, Performance and Betting menus, a direct Schedule link and clearer Explorer labels make pages easier to find.
